land.title: Kuongororwa kweStendi & Due Diligence
land.description: Usati wabhadhara stendi, tinoita shuwa kuti ndeyechokwadi, yakaiswa zvipandi zvakanaka uye yakachena pamutemo. Gweta rine ruzivo rinoongorora title (zviri mubasa redu). Mukuru wekanzuru anosimbisa zvipandi panzvimbo. Timu yedu inoyera stendi, inonyora GPS, uye inotora mifananidzo nevhidhiyo zvine zuva. Unogamuchira gwaro rakanyorwa rine yambiro dzese dzichitsanangurwa nemashoko ari nyore.

materials.title: Kutenga Zvivakwa
materials.description: Tiudze zvinodiwa pakuvaka kwako, tinounganidza makotesheni kubva kuvatengesi, akaenzaniswa. Hapana chinotengwa kusvika wabvumira nechinyorwa. Risiti yega yega inotorwa mufananidzo yogoverwa newe, uye kusvitswa kwezvinhu kunonyorwa nemifananidzo.

monitoring.title: Kushanyirwa kweSaiti & Kutariswa kweKuvaka
monitoring.description: Kushanyirwa kwenguva nenguva kwesaiti yako nemifananidzo ine zuva, zviyero uye mashoko ari nyore ekufambira mberi — kuti ugare uchiziva zviri kuitika chaizvo.

camera.title: Kamera yeSaiti Live (24/7)
camera.bullet1: Ona kuvakwa kwako live kubva chero kupi
camera.description: Kamera inoshanda nesolar pasaiti yako, inoratidza live uye inorekoda kucloud — kuti uone kuvakwa kwako kubva chero kupi, uye zvivakwa zvako zvichengetedzwe apo vavaki vari pasaiti.

servicesPage.title: Mabasa edu
servicesPage.intro: LBH ikambani yemabasa — timu yedu pachedu muZimbabwe inoita basa rako. Basa rega rega rinotanga nerunhare rwemahara, rwoteverwa nekotesheni yakanyorwa. Hapana mitengo inoratidzwa pachena; kotesheni yako ndeyako wega.
servicesPage.notifyHint: Iri basa riri kuuya. Taura "Ndizivise" parunhare rwako rwemahara, tokuzivisa richangotanga.

howPage.title: Zvinofamba sei
howPage.intro: Rwendo rumwe rwakajeka, kubva parunhare rwekutanga kusvika pagwaro rakapera. Unobvumira nhanho yega yega — hapana chinofamba usipo.
howPage.note: Unobhadhara rwendo rwega rwega rwatinofamba tichikumiririra. Kana tikakanganisa, tinogadzirisa nemari yedu. Hapana rwendo rwekuwedzera kana mutengo wekuwedzera unoitika usina kubvumira muportal.
howPage.stage1Text: Maminitsi 30–45, runhare kana vhidhiyo. Unotiudza nezvestendi yako kana kuvaka kwako. Hazvibhadharwi.
howPage.stage2Text: Mushure merunhare unogamuchira kotesheni yakanyorwa — muripo webasa nemari yerwendo inofungidzirwa, nenhamba dziri pachena. LBH chete ndiyo inoisa mitengo; mitengo haimboonekwi pawebsite ino.
howPage.stage3Text: Bvuma kotesheni muportal yako — zita rako nenguva zvinonyorwa sekubvuma kwakanyorwa. Unobhadhara dhipoziti ye50% nekadhi, EcoCash nedzimwe nzira, kana kutiudza kuti wabhadhara nebhanga kana remittance.
howPage.stage4Text: Timu yedu pachedu inoita basa — nemifananidzo nevhidhiyo zvine zuva neGPS. Vashandi vemumunda havamboona mitengo uye havambosaini basa ravo pachavo.
howPage.stage5Text: Gwaro rega rega remumunda rinotanga raenda kuadmin yeLBH. Admin inoriongorora yoriburitsa kwauri — hapana anosaina basa rake pachake.
howPage.stage6Text: Mhedziso yakajeka pamusoro, zvakawanikwa nemashoko ari nyore, zviyero, mifananidzo ine zuva nerisiti yega yega. Kana rwendo rwadhura zvishoma pane zvaifungidzirwa, unodzorerwa mari.
howPage.stage7Text: Kana gwaro raburitswa, unobhadhara 50% yasara. Zvapera — uye takagadzirira nhanho yako inotevera.

aboutPage.title: Nezve LBH
aboutPage.intro: LBH — Let's Build Home — inobatsira vaZimbabwe vanogara kunze kwenyika kuongorora stendi, kutenga zvivakwa nekutevera kuvaka kwavo kumusha, vasipo ikoko.
aboutPage.whoText: Tiri kambani yemabasa iri muZimbabwe. Hatisi musika uye hatitengesi minda — timu yedu pachedu inoita basa rako: gweta rine ruzivo rekuongorora title, architect/project manager, nevamiririri vemumunda vakavimbika.
aboutPage.whyText: Vanhu vakawandisa vari kunze kwenyika vakarasikirwa nemari nestendi dzenhema, zvivakwa zvinoshaikwa nekuvaka kusingafambi. LBH iripo kuti mari yako isafamba usina kubvumira — uye kuti uone, mumifananidzo nemagwaro, zviri kuitika chaizvo pamunda wako.
aboutPage.value2: Hapana anosaina basa rake pachake — gwaro rega rega rinoongororwa usati wariona.
aboutPage.value3: Risiti yega yega inotorwa mufananidzo yogoverwa.
aboutPage.teamText: Gweta rine ruzivo (title nekuongorora kwemutemo), architect / project manager, nevamiririri vemumunda muZimbabwe yese. Ruzivo rwuzere rwetimu rwuri kuuya.

termsPage.title: Mitemo yeBasa
termsPage.intro: Mitemo iyi inotonga mabasa anoitwa neLBH (Let's Build Home). Tsanangudzo dziri nyore dzinotanga pachikamu chega chega; idzo chikamu chemitemo.
termsPage.s1Text: LBH ikambani yemabasa iri muZimbabwe, inoshandiswa ne[LBH ZIMBABWE ENTITY NAME · REG NUMBER]. Tinoshanda nemirairo yako yakanyorwa: kuongorora stendi, kutenga zvivakwa nekutarisa kuvaka tichikumiririra. Hatisi musika, estate agent, kana mutengesi weminda kana zvivakwa.
termsPage.s2Text: Basa rega rega rinotanga nerunhare rwemahara, mushure tokutumira kotesheni yakanyorwa. Basa rinotanga chete mushure mekubvuma kotesheni nekubhadhara dhipoziti ye50%. Yasara inobhadharwa kana gwaro rako raburitswa. Mari yese iri muUS dollars.
termsPage.s3Text: Unobhadhara rwendo rwega rwega rwatinofamba tichikumiririra, sezvakanyorwa mukotesheni yako. Rwendo rwunoenzaniswa nerisiti: kana rwendo rwadhura zvishoma pane zvaifungidzirwa, mari yakasara inodzorerwa kwauri.
termsPage.s4Text: Hapana rwendo rwekuwedzera, faini, muripo wekanzuru kana umwe mutengo wekuwedzera unoitwa usina kutanga wabvumira muportal. Basa rinomira kusvika wabvuma kana kuramba.
termsPage.s5Text: Kana LBH ikakanganisa, LBH inogadzirisa nemari yayo. Izvi hazvibati matambudziko anokonzerwa nevamwe, zviremera, kana ruzivo rwawakapa rwusina kururama.
termsPage.s6Text: Gwaro rekuongorora stendi iongororo yepanyama neyemagwaro yakaitwa pazuva chairo. Harisi vimbiso yetitle, kukosha kana zvichaitika mberi, uye harisi zano remutemo kunze kwezvakawanikwa negweta zvakanyorwa mariri.
termsPage.s7Text: LBH inoshanda nemirairo yemutengi. Ndiwe une basa rekuona kuti mirairo nemagwaro zvawatipa zvakarurama.
termsPage.s8Text: Mibvunzo nezvemitemo iyi: tisvikire neemail kana WhatsApp papeji yeTaura Nesu.

privacyPage.title: Mutemo weKuvanzika
privacyPage.intro: LBH inoremekedza kuvanzika kwako. Mutemo uyu unotsanangura zvatinotora, sei, nekodzero dzako. Wakanyorwa kuti uenderane neCyber and Data Protection Act yeZimbabwe [Chapter 12:07] uye, nekuti vatengi vedu vazhinji vanogara kunze, UK GDPR.
privacyPage.s1Text: Ruzivo rwekubata (zita, email, nhamba yeWhatsApp, nyika), ruzivo nezvestendi kana kuvaka kwako rwaunosarudza kugovera, magwaro aunoisa (seititle deeds nezvibvumirano zvekutengesa), zvinyorwa zvekubhadhara, nemashoko aunotitumira.
privacyPage.s2Text: Kuita mabasa aunokumbira: kubhuka runhare, kugadzira makotesheni, kuongorora stendi, kutenga zvivakwa, kukupira mhinduro, nekubhadharisa. Hatitengesi data rako uye hatirishandisi kushambadzira kwevamwe.
privacyPage.s3Text: Data rako rinochengetwa nevachengetedzi vecloud vakavimbika. Magwaro anochengetwa munzvimbo yakavanzika, inosvikika chete nemalink ane nguva yakatarwa newe nevashandi veLBH vakabvumirwa.
privacyPage.s4Text: Iwe chete nevashandi veLBH vanorida pabasa rako. Vashandi vemumunda vanoona chete ruzivo rwebasa rwavanoda — kwete mitengo, makotesheni kana kubhadhara kwako.
privacyPage.s5Text: Unogona kukumbira kopi yedata rako, kugadziriswa kwedata risina kururama, kana kudzimwa kweaccount nedata rako. Zvishandiso zvekuburitsa nekudzima zviri musettings yeportal yako, kana utiudze isu tozviita.
privacyPage.s6Text: Tinochengeta zvinyorwa zvemabasa akapera (kusanganisira magwaro nezvinyorwa zvekubhadhara) kwenguva inodiwa nemutemo yemitero neaudit, tozvidzima.
privacyPage.s7Text: Pamubvunzo wese wekuvanzika, tisvikire neemail kana WhatsApp papeji yeTaura Nesu.

faq.title: Mibvunzo inobvunzwa nevanhu vasati vavaka neLBH.
faq.intro: Mhinduro pfupi dzechokwadi. Kana mubvunzo wako usipo, bhuka runhare rwemahara utibvunze pachedu.
faq.moreText: Taura nesu parunhare rwemahara kana paWhatsApp.

what.a: Tinobatsira vanhu vanogara kunze kwenyika kuvaka muZimbabwe. Timu yedu inoongorora stendi usati watenga, inounganidza nekuenzanisa makotesheni evatengesi, inotenga chete zvawabvumira, inotarisira kuvaka nhanho nenhanho uye inokuzivisa nemifananidzo ine zuva, marisiti nemagwaro akanyorwa.

there.a: Kwete. Zvese zvinoitika kuburikidza neaccount yako yeLBH neWhatsApp — kutaurirana parunhare kana pavhidhiyo, makotesheni nemvumo muaccount yako, nemifananidzo nemagwaro aunogona kuvhura parunhare rwako chero kwaunogara.

cost.a: Runhare rwekutanga ndorwemahara. Mushure maro unogamuchira kotesheni yakanyorwa ine muripo webasa nemari yerwendo inofungidzirwa. Mitengo inoenderana nestendi yako nekuvaka kwako, saka haiiswi pawebhusaiti.

pay.a: Unobvuma kotesheni muaccount yako wobhadhara dhipoziti ye50% — online nekadhi kana mobile money, kana nebhanga kana remittance, wotiudza reference. Yasara inobhadharwa kana gwaro rako raburitswa.

money.a: Kwete. Build Account yako chinyorwa chemari yako yekuvaka — yawakatumira, yakashandiswa neyasara — kwete account yebhangi. Hapana chinotengwa usina kubvumira.

proof.q: Ndingaziva sei kuti basa rakaitwa chaizvo?
proof.a: Timu yedu inotora mifananidzo nevhidhiyo zvine zuva pasaiti, kutenga kwese kune risiti yakatorwa mufananidzo, uye gwaro rega rega remumunda rinoongororwa neLBH risati raburitswa kwauri. Hapana anosaina basa rake pachake.

family.a: Hongu, kana ukavakoka. MuBuild Account yako unogona kukoka mhuri kuti ingoona chete, kana kuti iise marisiti emari yavakabata. Vanoona chete zvaunogovana navo.

mistake.a: Kana tikakanganisa, tinogadzirisa nemari yedu. Nzendo dzekuwedzera kana mitengo yekuwedzera hazviitiki usina kubvumira muaccount yako.

privacy.a: Iwe chete, vashandi veLBH vari kushanda pachikumbiro chako, nemhuri yaunokoka. Magwaro nemarisiti zvinochengetwa zvakavanzika uye zvinovhurwa nemalink akachengeteka anopera nekukurumidza.

languages.a: Webhusaiti neaccount yako zvinowanikwa muChirungu, chiShona nesiNdebele.
